data.title: Applications per opening on a national IT job board (DOU)
data.summary: Platform-reported counts for a single national IT job board. In March 2026 the board carried 7,987 openings and recorded 131,000 applications from 22,800 candidates — an average of 26 applications per opening, and 132 per opening in front-end development. The first quarter of 2026 carried 22,900 openings, 23% more than the same quarter of 2025. These are one board's own counts for one country, not a market-wide measure, and the average conceals the spread: the ratio differs by a factor of five between specialisations on the same board in the same month.
